Daily Active Customers

HardProQuerying BasicsAggregation & Grouping

Calculate daily active customers (DAC). For each order_date, show the order_date, the number of unique customers who placed orders (active_customers), and the total_orders on that day. Sort by order_date. This DAU/DAC metric is the #1 most-asked analytics question at Meta, Google, and Amazon.
